agents.name: craft
rules: Use full descriptive identifiers in C++/Python/JS. Reject opaque abbreviations without domain meaning; preserve required ABI/protocol/register names. JS/TS conventions apply only to JS/TS. For changed UI strings/layout apply localization and viewport/DPI guidance only where relevant.
Load the actual configured skill guides before reviewing; resolve Codex aliases through the marketplace links in AGENTS.md. Do not claim a skill was applied if its guide was unavailable.

Every new feature must be human-usable without AI: clear entry point/help/defaults/progress/actionable failures and a reproducible human workflow. Do not accept a chain of internal Python/PowerShell/RPC commands as the primary user interface, or document an unimplemented friendly command as available.

Human usability includes README/help/documentation/descriptions/examples/messages: explain purpose, starting steps, expected results and recovery for the intended reader, define terms, and do not require AI to fill missing steps or decode internal jargon.

Human docs/help/descriptions must not expose numerical memory addresses, pointer/structure byte offsets or address-derived disassembler labels. Require meaningful function/event/type symbols with purpose explained; numeric bindings stay in source/private evidence. Preserve original technical records privately and retain dated conclusions when correcting old docs. Treat an address-only explanation as a documentation finding.

The knowledge website is the canonical home of living manuals, references and explanations. Repository README/AGENTS must link there; reject parallel maintained documentation copies. Preserve dated/private evidence separately; do not publish raw memory addresses or personal working logs.

Every new or changed article requires five separate independent critic identities, one for each lens: newcomer clarity, technical accuracy, reproducibility, structure/navigation, terminology/translation. Use the marketplace critique method, exact locations, failure modes, severity and evidence; freeze each round, merge by location, fix confirmed substantial defects, record content hashes and finding dispositions, at most three rounds. Do not count author self-review or one generalist as five critics.
